title: Give removed-session root journal maintenance a reachable production owner
outcome: Claim-less removed-session root journal maintenance runs through an existing bounded production owner instead of relying on an optional naming branch that cannot be funded by production control allowance.
acceptance: A production-reachable existing lifecycle owner admits the claim-less removed-root sweep and its retained authority recovery without consuming naming's mandatory control allowance or adding a parallel registry or scheduler.

A deterministic production-configuration fixture leaves a NamingSessionRemoved journal after its naming session disappears, invokes the real owner, and observes the canonical lifecycle settlement or a retained typed refusal; no synthetic larger naming allowance or real minute wait is used.
Issued Engram calls retain the minimum operation window, fair cursor progress and current store/run/fence guards; the source review and exact-input validation cover the changed owner.
